status: DRAFT — NOT DECIDED; NO FREEZE, NO GRANT, NO RUN
proposal: Provisionally freeze the Path A target sets and manifest target block, then run the planned cells, then require both C1 and C4 to pass; either failing or being unmeasurable makes the run A1 VOID — C1/C4.

provisional_freeze.scope: Path A target sets and manifest target block for one registered attempt
provisional_freeze.meaning: The result is provisional until C1/C4 pass; the target identity is not provisional and a VOID does not unfreeze it.

gate_order: P0 compliance, target feasibility and the Path A estimand record stand.
The owner records a provisional freeze of the Path A target sets and manifest target block.
The owner records the dated grant; this remains a separate act.
a1_result.assemble reads the actual cell parts and reports the observed C1 denominators and C4 deltas.
Both C1 and C4 must pass; either failing or being unmeasurable makes the run A1 VOID — C1/C4 before any model is read.

denominator_floor.if_adopted: The observed minimum paired-control denominator below 60 on any seed or path makes the run VOID, even at 59/59.
denominator_floor.if_recorded: A perfect 59/59 is VOID; the fraction cannot rescue a denominator below 60.

void_conditions.condition: No paired-control denominator is available for a required seed or required row. A missing denominator is not zero.
The observed minimum paired-control denominator is below 60 on any seed or path, even if every available row is retained. The floor is recorded in DECISION-A1-PATH-A-C1-RULE.md.
On any seed, A- carrier preservation is below 0.95, or K- served preservation is below 0.95.
The non-target stream is absent, incomplete, or has no measurable paired delta.
Any measurable non-target A, K or Y neighbour delta exceeds 0.05.
Required cell parts are missing, duplicated, or cannot be paired for C1/C4. The gate is unmeasurable; it is not a zero-row pass.

void_meaning: The experiment did not produce an admissible comparison.
No causal model is selected: no M-K, M-N, M-S or M-R label.
No M1 branch is assigned, and no V2, capability, transfer, external-advantage or generalization claim may be read.
C7 and C8 are not adjudicated; if not already evaluated, they are reported as NOT ADJUDICATED — RUN VOID.
The run is not a negative result and is not evidence for or against any model; it is not a null finding or failed replication.
Observed C1 denominators and C4 row counts are retained for audit; a missing denominator is reported as missing, never as 0.0.
The planned seeds and cells are consumed; no substitute seed, extra cell or post-hoc target may be added.
No row may be dropped, no threshold changed, no target re-selected and no denominator expanded after the failure is seen.
Parts and observed counts may support instrument diagnostics, but may not be re-labelled as an A1 result.
The target freeze remains recorded; a VOID does not return the attempt to an unfrozen state or authorise a second attempt under the same registration.
void_does_not_mean: That the carrier model or the two-path model is false.
That C1 or C4 can never pass.
That the two-path model is untestable in principle.
That a new selector, new target count or new threshold is licensed under the same registration.
That a failed C1 may be re-read as a C4 problem, or a failed C4 as a C1 problem.
That the run may be reported as a near pass or a descriptively supportive result.
That a second attempt is authorised. A further attempt requires a new registered design, a fresh seed block and a new dated owner grant.

status_distinctions.when: The run did not execute: missing target set, missing rule, or no grant.
status_distinctions.records: A preparation or authorisation stop, not an experimental outcome.

status_distinctions.when: The planned run executed but the C1/C4 validity test failed or was unmeasurable.
status_distinctions.records: No admissible comparison; no model read.

status_distinctions.when: The current C1 result-gate failure when the comparison exists but model separation is not achieved.
status_distinctions.records: A scientific result-gate outcome under the current disposition.

status_distinctions.when: The current disposition for a gate that cannot be measured under the registered design.
status_distinctions.records: A design/measurement limit under the current disposition.

no_rescue: A passing C4 cannot rescue a failing C1.
A passing C1 cannot rescue a failing C4.
A passing C2, C3, C5, C7 or C8 cannot rescue a C1/C4 VOID.
A larger denominator discovered after the run cannot be used to re-score C1; the C4 non-target rows must be registered before the run.
A failed or unmeasurable gate is terminal for this registration under the one-attempt rule.

report_shape.not_evidence: A gate decision, not a causal, capability or transfer result.

adoption_effect: Record a new dated provisional-freeze decision that distinguishes provisional evidentiary status from final target identity.

adoption: Adoption is a separate dated owner decision. It does not reserve seeds, issue a grant, run a cell or create evidence, except where the owner explicitly records seed reservation in the same act.
not_evidence: A proposed gate order and a definition of VOID. No cell has run; this is not an A1 result, freeze, grant or capability claim.
